title: This Serious Home Projector Lets Cinephiles Make All the Adjustments They Could Want
summary: The VisionMaster Max produces a seriously bright image. Valerion’s cheaper VisionMaster Pro 2 ($2,999) retains key features, including Google TV, RGB triple-laser projection, optical zoom, and EBL, but it loses the Max’s iris and vertical lens shift.
